<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="אייר_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518918306_theRebbe_932" batchId="meluket-_D7_90_D7_99_D7_99_D7_A8_meluket__BH_POST_1766518918306_theRebbe_932__p004">
  <section v="9">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Through this, one then reaches the fourth year, where Tiferet is drawn into Malchut, and one's service becomes drawing additional light rather than repelling evil, though this is only from the aspect of revelations.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And through this, afterwards one comes to the fourth year,</t>
    <t s="1">that Tiferet is also drawn into Malchut,</t>
    <t s="2">for in the service of man, this is that in his thought, speech, and action, there is also drawn from the essence of the emotions,</t>
    <t s="3">love and fear,</t>
    <t s="4">and also the joy of the heart in the beauty of Havayah and the splendor of His majesty, which comes through gazing upon the glory of the King49.</t>
    <t s="5">And then,</t>
    <t s="6">his service is not to repel the evil</t>
    <t s="7">[for when he has love of Havayah,</t>
    <t s="8">evil is repulsive to him50</t>
    <t s="9">and he does not need to repel it]</t>
    <t s="10">but rather to draw additional light.</t>
    <t s="11">For this is that in the fourth year, all its fruit shall be holy, praises to Havayah,</t>
    <t s="12">for the matter of praise is as explained in Likkutei Torah47</t>
    <t s="13">in the explanation of the verse51</t>
    <t s="14">"And You are holy, enthroned upon the praises of Israel,"</t>
    <t s="15">that He, blessed be He, in His own essence is holy and separate,</t>
    <t s="16">and through the praises of Israel He is enthroned and drawn downward.</t>
    <t s="17">And it may be said,</t>
    <t s="18">that it is analogous to the service from the aspect of Nefesh-Ruach-Neshamah</t>
    <t s="19">("The heavens are My throne and the earth is My footstool")</t>
    <t s="20">and from the aspect of the encompassing lights Chayah and Yechidah</t>
    <t s="21">("house"),</t>
    <t s="22">through which the internal and encompassing [lights]52 are drawn and revealed</t>
    <t s="23">from above.</t>
    <t s="24">However, this drawing is only from the aspect of the revelations,</t>
    <t s="25">and as explained in Likkutei Torah46</t>
    <t s="26">in the explanation of the verse "We give thanks to You and praise Your glorious name,"</t>
    <t s="27">that the thanksgiving is "to You,"</t>
    <t s="28">to His Essence and Selfhood,</t>
    <t s="29">and the praise is only to His name, blessed be He53,</t>
    <t s="30">"to Your glorious name."</t>
  </section>
  <section v="10">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Through this one then reaches the fifth year, which is the addition of light drawn from the tip of the Yud, Keter, corresponding to faith above intellect, where the wonder of Atzmus is felt and only faith and thanksgiving apply.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And through this, afterwards one comes to the fifth year,</t>
    <t s="1">"to add to you its produce,"</t>
    <t s="2">an addition of light drawn from the tip of the Yud,</t>
    <t s="3">Keter.</t>
    <t s="4">For it may be said,</t>
    <t s="5">that its meaning in the service of man is faith that is above intellect,</t>
    <t s="6">that his faith is from the recognition that "no thought can grasp Him at all."</t>
    <t s="7">For in this faith there are two virtues.</t>
    <t s="8">That it is in His Essence, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="9">and that the Essence is in revelation.</t>
    <t s="10">That is, in this faith54</t>
    <t s="11">the wonder of Atzmus is felt,</t>
    <t s="12">that all praises and hymns are only "to Your glorious name,"</t>
    <t s="13">and regarding His Essence, blessed be He, no praise applies,</t>
    <t s="14">only faith and thanksgiving55.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="11">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The fruits of the fourth year are eaten only in Jerusalem, indicating a measured revelation, while those of the fifth year are eaten everywhere, indicating a revelation beyond measure, drawing from the Essence of Ein Sof to make a dwelling for Him in the lowest place.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">7)</t>
    <t s="1">And it may be said,</t>
    <t s="2">that this is that the fruits of the fourth year are eaten only in Jerusalem56,</t>
    <t s="3">and the fruits of the fifth year are eaten in any place,</t>
    <t s="4">for the revelation of the fourth year is within measure and limitation,</t>
    <t s="5">and therefore the praise of these fruits is that they are brought to Jerusalem to laud and praise to heaven57,</t>
    <t s="6">and the revelation of the fifth year,</t>
    <t s="7">since it is above measure and limitation,</t>
    <t s="8">therefore the thanksgiving to Havayah for the addition in this produce58</t>
    <t s="9">is in any place</t>
    <t s="10">(and even in fruits that have no holiness,</t>
    <t s="11">to the extent that they are eaten even in impurity).</t>
    <t s="12">And through the thanksgiving to Havayah for these fruits that have no holiness,</t>
    <t s="13">the drawing is from the Essence of Ein Sof</t>
    <t s="14">(which is above any relation to the Sefiros)59,</t>
    <t s="15">and is drawn downward most greatly,</t>
    <t s="16">and through this the intention is completed that the Holy One, blessed be He, desired to have a dwelling place for Himself in the lower realms60,</t>
    <t s="17">that the lowest, below which there is no lower61,</t>
    <t s="18">becomes a dwelling place for Him, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="19">for Him, for His Essence62.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
